title: CompetencyBasedProxyCareerTransitionDatasetSchema
description: Schema definition for the competency-based proxy-labeled career transition dataset used to train the PathForge transition readiness model.

archetype_id.description: Candidate base persona archetype identifier used for grouped splitting

target_role.description: Target technology occupation title among the 20 PathForge target roles

skill_match_score.description: Direct core competency overlap ratio between candidate skills and target role

market_demand_score.description: Normalized labor market demand index for the candidate's existing skillset

ai_exposure_score.description: Empirical automation vulnerability index of candidate skills

transferability_score.description: Average portability of candidate skills across adjacent technical disciplines

skill_breadth_score.description: Breadth ratio across technical domains (frontend, backend, cloud, data, security)

emerging_skill_alignment.description: Presence ratio of modern frontier tech competencies (LLMs, Kubernetes, MLOps, etc.)

skill_gap_score.description: Ratio of missing required competencies relative to total role requirements

experience_years.description: Stated or estimated professional experience years

target_role_experience_requirement.description: Standard industry baseline experience expected for target role level

experience_gap.description: Difference between candidate experience and target role requirement

number_of_matching_skills.description: Absolute count of possessed skills aligning with the target role

number_of_missing_skills.description: Absolute count of missing skills required for the target role

transition_effort_score.description: Normalized upskilling effort index based on required study weeks

readiness_label.description: Proxy ground truth classification label derived from competency benchmark rules
